detail.longDescription: Self-hosting is great until something breaks and you realize you don't have a backup. In my latest post, I share how I use Restic for secure, encrypted, and incremental backups across local and remote backends (like SFTP/S3). Includes a ready-to-use bash script, cron automation, and—most importantly—how to test your restores! https:// blog.tomasnorre.dk/blog/backup -with-restic/ # devops # linux # opensource # selfhosting # restic
